channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Brad Stevens | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Brad Stevens from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Kendrick Perkins on Brad Stevens, Jaylen Brown
item.description:
Kendrick Perkins:

“They could come out with all the reports that they want to, but again, some of the stuff, and I'm not saying he's a criminal, but I'm saying the streaming and stuff like that, that has been a turnoff to a lot of people. But if you're Brad Stevens, you cannot bring that energy back into your locker room becauseif I'm Jaylen Brown, I feel some type of way coming back and I'm saying, 'Well damn, you didn't try to trade me twice. How you expect me to act?'I just came off the best season of my career and here I was on the chopping block.”

Kendrick Perkins on Brad Stevens, Jaylen Brown, Jun 30, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Nate Oats on Brad Stevens
item.description:
Oats said via SiriusXM Radio.

“Probably the one who’s done it best most recently is Brad Stevens, and man, he went to a national championship at Butler.”

Nate Oats on Brad Stevens, Feb 25, 2026. Source: On3.com.

item.title: Bill Chisholm on Brad Stevens
item.description:
“I want to listen to what [Stevens] has to say and hear how he thinks about basketball. He’s given me his sense of where the team is and where things are going, and I just want to help him any way I can. So, it’s great. He’s a basketball genius and there’s no two ways about it, and it’s a privilege to get to hear what he thinks about things.”

Bill Chisholm on Brad Stevens, Mar 25, 2025. Source: Boston Globe.

item.title: Wyc Grousbeck on Brad Stevens
item.description:
To solve this issue, Grousbeck pointed to his faith in the front office to keep Boston’s contending window amid second apron concerns.

“We have Brad Stevens, the reigning Executive of The Year, and thank god we do,”

Wyc Grousbeck on Brad Stevens, Mar 22, 2025. Source: Booth Newspapers.

item.title: Bill Chisholm on Brad Stevens, Joe Mazzulla
item.description:
New Boston Celtics owner Bill Chisholm tells ESPN:

“The team is in a great place right now, and I'm very sensitive to that. Wyc, Brad (Stevens) and Joe (Mazzulla) have done amazing jobs... My approach is to win and raise banners. That's in the near term and the long term.”

Bill Chisholm on Brad Stevens, Joe Mazzulla, Mar 20, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Evan Turner on Brad Stevens
item.description:
Evan Turner:

“Luckily, shout out to Brad Stevens. He was like, 'Bro, I can’t let people treat you like that.' I don’t know what changed, but he gave me a little bit of money and helped me. No joke, he helped me get my career back. Even when I left that situation with the Pacers, you gotta think—I went from being with the Sixers, where I was supposed to be a megastar, to hitting the ground hard. You get to a point where, like Jeff can relate, you’re either going overseas or you’re staying to fight. That was some real [stuff]. We laugh about it now, but at the time, it was real. Obviously, it didn’t stay dark forever.”

Evan Turner on Brad Stevens, Sep 29, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Lonnie Walker IV on Brad Stevens
item.description:
“Brad Stevens had seen something in me and just gave me the opportunity to have the (Exhibit 10 contract) and earn my spot,”

Lonnie Walker IV on Brad Stevens, Sep 28, 2024. Source: Boston Sports Journal.

item.title: Lonnie Walker on Brad Stevens
item.description:
Lonnie Walker:

“Brad Stevens mentioned there’s a possibility that I might spend some time in the G-League with Maine, and honestly, I’m perfectly fine with that… you gotta take it on the chin, you gotta continue to work, you gotta continue to be prepared and just keep being ready.”

Lonnie Walker on Brad Stevens, Sep 25, 2024. Source: CLNSMedia.com.

item.title: Jayson Tatum on Brad Stevens
item.description:
“He always knew that I wanted him here. I would always tell him like, ‘Man, I don’t get involved with any of thosetalks.’ I never went to [Celtics president of basketball operations] Brad Stevens or went to any player like, ‘Yo, I want this guy in, I want this guy out of here.’ I show up and I want to do my job and play basketball. And looking back on in those moments, I didn’t know how that could affect somebody, because I was never in that situation. I feel like maybe I could have done a better job of publicly saying, ‘No, we don’t want anybody, we want JB.’ I just was always like, ‘I want to stay out of it.’”

Jayson Tatum on Brad Stevens, Jul 25, 2024. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Brad Stevens
item.description:
“Brad Stevens did a great job, but it doesn’t happen without Danny sending Paul and Kevin to Brooklyn. That secured the future for the Celtics. They’re going to carry this team for the next 10 years.”

Danny Ainge on Brad Stevens, Jul 12, 2024. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Pat Riley on Brad Stevens
item.description:
Wes Goldberg:Pat Riley on the Boston Celtics:

“They are this year I think the best team in the league with the best roster in the league… Brad Stevens did a great job.”

Pat Riley on Brad Stevens, May 6, 2024. Source: Twitter @wcgoldberg.

item.title: Marcus Smart on Brad Stevens, Joe Mazzulla
item.description:
“I went to the gym next day to get my stuff, talked to Brad (Stevens) and Joe (Mazzulla),”

Marcus Smart on Brad Stevens, Joe Mazzulla, Jul 2, 2023. Source: CLNSMedia.com.

item.title: Jayson Tatum on Brad Stevens, Jaylen Brown
item.description:
Jayson Tatum on what he and Brad Stevens told Jaylen Brown during the past offseason:

“Just reassuring the obvious — that we need him. He’s a big part of this team, this franchise. Without him, we can’t reach our goal.”

Jayson Tatum on Brad Stevens, Jaylen Brown, Mar 25, 2023. Source: Twitter @hoopshype.

item.title: Jayson Tatum on Brad Stevens
item.description:
“I thought that if teams knew I was about to have a kid, they were gonna think I wasn’t focused and that they wouldn’t pick me – so I was terrified. I didn’t want anybody to know, which was extremely selfish. SoI remember, I told Brad Stevens. I remember we were on the plane and one of the trainers knew. He was like, ‘Have you told Brad yet? … Isn’t she due next week? You might miss a game.’ I’m like, ‘Oh s–t.’”

Jayson Tatum on Brad Stevens, Oct 27, 2022. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Brad Stevens
item.description:
“I like their coach [Brad Stevens at the time]. I feel they have some good pieces.”

Kevin Durant on Brad Stevens, Jul 6, 2022. Source: Heavy.com.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Brad Stevens
item.description:
Jared Weiss:Steve Kerr on Brad Stevens:

“He's somebody I think who has figured out what he wants at this stage of lifeand that's what we all have to figure out in this business. I had to hold off on coaching until my kids were done with high school. I think he was the opposite.”

Steve Kerr on Brad Stevens, Jun 12, 2022. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: Wyc Grousbeck on Brad Stevens
item.description:
Jared Weiss:Wyc Grousbeck on if Brad Stevens would have remained Celtics coach next season:

“Who knows? If he wanted to be, he would be. He was not going to be let go. If he wanted to be the coach, he would be the coach. But he preferred to be President.”

Wyc Grousbeck on Brad Stevens, Jun 29, 2021. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: Michael Malone on Brad Stevens
item.description:
“Like Brad Stevens and I have had more conversations in the last 60 days than we’ve ever had because we’re down here and we’re in the same boat. It’s unique, and we’re trying to make the best of it.”

Michael Malone on Brad Stevens, Sep 14, 2020. Source: Forbes.com.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Brad Stevens, Billy Donovan, Taylor Jenkings
item.description:
“'Billy the Kid' (Billy Donovan) in OKC -- with a team that didn't necessarily have high expectations -- has done a great job. Taylor Jenkins has done a great job in Memphis. But why don't I give it to my former Indiana buddy Brad Stevens for doing a great job losing Kyrie Irving and a few others? Al Horford changing the whole identity of their team and having a great season. I would probably vote for Brad.”

Frank Vogel on Brad Stevens, Billy Donovan, Taylor Jenkings, Jul 18, 2020. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Jayson Tatum on Brad Stevens
item.description:
Jayson Tatum:

“My agent was like, ‘Just think about it.’ So we hang up, I’m like, ‘I’m not going to this workout right now. I’m cool.’But then Coach K called me right after my agent did and he was like, ‘Jayson, the Celtics called, they want you to come work out. I think Brad Stevens is a great coach and it’s a great place to be. You’ll learn a lot.’So I’m like, ‘Ugh, all right. I’ll go.’”

Jayson Tatum on Brad Stevens, May 11, 2020. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Kyrie Irving on Brad Stevens
item.description:
Kyrie on Brad Stevens letting his players be human:

“It means a lot. I mean, it means a lot. I could go on for a long time about being human in this business, but I know that Brad understands it. He appreciates all of us for who we are as people first and then as players.”

Kyrie Irving on Brad Stevens, Mar 8, 2019. Source: Twitter @Tom_NBA.

item.title: Gordon Hayward on Brad Stevens
item.description:
Gordon Hayward on Cs finding roles this year:

“Coach Stevens will put us in position to be successful. I have no doubt about that.”

Gordon Hayward on Brad Stevens, Sep 22, 2018. Source: Twitter @AdamHimmelsbach.

item.title: Robert Williams on Brad Stevens
item.description:
Tom Westerholm:Rob Williams:

“(Stevens) is one of the most hands on coaches I’ve ever worked with. … If you have a question for him, his office is always open as far as basketball and off the court.”

Robert Williams on Brad Stevens, Sep 5, 2018. Source: Twitter @Tom_NBA.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Danny Ainge, Brad Stevens
item.description:
“That’s Danny (Ainge) and Brad (Stevens) and those guys — and, I mean, obviously the players, too,”

Doc Rivers on Danny Ainge, Brad Stevens, Jul 15, 2018. Source: Boston Herald.

item.title: Semi Ojeleye on Brad Stevens
item.description:
Celtics: Semi Ojeleye on Brad Stevens asking him to become even more versatile defensively:

“It’s just realizing that you CAN have that impact ... It’s a different mindset, but it’s something I can do.”

Semi Ojeleye on Brad Stevens, Jul 12, 2018. Source: Twitter @celtics.

item.title: Semi Ojeleye on Brad Stevens
item.description:
Semi Ojeleye on Brad Stevens:

“When he’s not coaching, he’s just a guy that you wouldn’t even think coaches the Celtics. He’s just so approachable.”

Semi Ojeleye on Brad Stevens, Jul 7, 2018. Source: Twitter @celtics.

item.title: Marcus Smart on Brad Stevens
item.description:
Marcus Smart on Brad Stevens’ play calling:

“Some of the plays he draws up you go, ‘Ehhh, I don’t know if that’s going to work.’ Then it does and it’s like, ‘Sorry I ever doubted you.’”

Marcus Smart on Brad Stevens, May 17, 2018. Source: Twitter @celtics.

item.title: Brian Scalabrine on Brad Stevens
item.description:
Scalabrine:

“He’s a great coach and he puts guys in a great position, but I feel like it’s a little demeaning when people don’t give credit to the players. As good of a coach as Brad Stevens is…. I think it’s a little disrespectful to the players when they win, all the credit goes to Brad. The credit should go to the players who do the work day in and day out.”

Brian Scalabrine on Brad Stevens, May 16, 2018. Source: For The Win.

item.title: Paul Pierce on Al Horford, Kevin Love, Brad Stevens, Terry Rozier, Jayson Tatum
item.description:
Paul Pierce:

“If you look down, I’ll take [Al] Horford over Kevin Love. The way Tatum’s been playing, Rozier, nobody on Cleveland is playing as well as those guys and they have the advantage pretty much every night at coaching.“Ty Lue’s a great coach but Brad Stevens is the best coach in basketball right now. No offence to [San Antonio Spurs coach Gregg] Popovich, but he’s the best coach in the NBA and that says a lot. “Look at what he’s doing with the Celtics. If they end up in the Finals? Come on. “We had them written off to not even make the playoffs or go this far in the playoffs without Gordon [Hayward] or Kyrie [Irving].”

Paul Pierce on Al Horford, Kevin Love, Brad Stevens, Terry Rozier, Jayson Tatum, May 9, 2018. Source: The Daily Express.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Brad Stevens
item.description:
Jaylen Brown:

“When it came down to an ATO for (a big bucket), we were getting layups. I tip my hat to Brad Stevens.”

Jaylen Brown on Brad Stevens, May 5, 2018. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.
